title: Aureline M5 rotation/revoke-event row component
description: Names the credential lifecycle state — active current, refresh needed, rotation due, revoked, expired, or superseded — so a user always sees what rotation or revoke will impact and a pending rotation or revoke is never shown as active. Canonical per-component contract frozen by the M5 credential component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-credential-component-matrix.schema.json); downstream M5 rows point at this schema instead of restating credential UI truth by hand. Raw secret values, tokens, passphrases, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
